translations.text: I now wish to remind you, who know all things, that God once saved the people from Egypt, but afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
These are grumblers and complainers, following their own desires. Their mouths speak arrogant things, and they flatter people for their own advantage.
To the only God and our Savior, Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, greatness, power, and authority, before all ages, both now and for all ages. Amen.
